findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "示例问题" 4.4:1 needs 4.5:1; "输入问题后，系统从资料中检索证据，逐条给出原文摘录与出处。" 4.4:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Geist, but the page renders Noto Sans CJK SC.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: 47% of the first screen is one empty block (1440×420px at 0,480).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: 8 of 8 numeric table cells are left-aligned.
findings.fix: Right-align numbers, amounts and percentages (and their column headers) so the digits line up.
Name the screen in an h1 at the top of the canvas (18–28px): "Overview", "Payouts", the project's name.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "EduForge" (14px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.
